title: Fixed Deposit Premature Break vs Overdraft Option

dialogue_turns.speaker: USER
dialogue_turns.utterance: I need 1 lakh rupees urgently for 10 days. Should I break my 5 lakh Fixed Deposit?

dialogue_turns.speaker: AGENT
dialogue_turns.utterance: Breaking your 5 lakh FD will attract a 1.0% premature withdrawal penalty and reduce your earned interest rate. Alternatively, NexBank offers an instant Overdraft against Fixed Deposit: you can borrow 1 lakh at just 1% above your FD rate, pay interest only for the 10 days you use it (approx. INR 230 total), and keep your full FD earning interest. Which option would you prefer?

metadata.design_pattern: Graceful Degradation (shows cost-saving alternative to destructive action)
